title: GitHub Pages remains in legacy mode; publisher ordering is the control
detail: The official GitHub Pages API read at 2026-10-23T09:43:46Z reported build_type=legacy from main:/. The attempted change to build_type=workflow returned HTTP 403, Resource not accessible by integration, so this session does not claim Actions is the sole configured publisher. The repository workflow waits for legacy builds, deploys the verified artifact last, syncs rendered HTML—not deterministic data fixtures—into the root, waits again and redeploys/verifies the artifact. A repository owner can remove this race in Pages settings by selecting GitHub Actions as the source.

detail: At 09:53:43Z the plain public executive summary, data/latest.json and data/origination.json agreed on the 09:23:57Z snapshot (30 active fixtures and 30 picks). PR #214 then merged at 09:54:27Z. The interim artifact deployment completed at 09:54:56Z, but that commit's legacy Pages build completed later, at 09:55:18Z. At 10:00:08Z the plain HTML still carried the 09:23:57Z snapshot while both plain JSON files had regressed to the checked-in 15 October fixtures. A later merge at 10:17:37Z produced another legacy build that landed at 10:19:09Z during verification of a 10:18:15Z artifact deployment, and that publisher run failed with stale public HTML. This incident is retained after recovery; it is not a current-picks claim.
